study type: cohort analysis (secondary analysis of an RCT cohort)
outcome: Maternal anthropometric measures (mid-upper arm, hip circumferences)
cohort: A cohort of 715 ethnically diverse women with obesity from the UK, who participated in the UPBEAT antenatal lifestyle intervention trial.
finding: Increased maternal BMI was associated with decreased duration of exclusive breastfeeding, while any breastfeeding at 6-months postpartum was associated with a healthier maternal metabolic profile, reduced weight retention, and improved anthropometric measures, except in women of Black ethnicity.
